name: Forum Link
description: An upstream or downstream relationship between two forums (G-4 mapping, and the interconnectivity view). One child table used by two parent fields, which is why the parent index is composite — see 03-schema.md §7.1.

fields.label: Direction
fields.description: Set from the field the row sits in; the inverse is visible from the other forum.

fields.label: Relationship Type
fields.options:
Reports To
Delegates To
Escalates To
Informs
